online_interval.ic_start_event: target_query_begin: the first operation on the public point (its scan-origin hash), after base, index, rank stage and linear algebra are complete
online_interval.ic_stop_event: recovery_check_end: [d]G = Q evaluated in the producer
online_interval.replay: both certificates replayed after the run in oracle.py, outside both producers
online_interval.rho_start_event: after_target_built: the walk's first start [c]G + Q, after the curve, jump table and target point are ready
online_interval.rho_stop_event: recovery_check_true: a distinguished-point collision returned d with [d]G = Q

rho_policy.collision_policy: distinguished points in one table that starts empty in every process; a stored point reached with a different coefficient of Q gives d, checked as [d]G = Q
rho_policy.walk_policy: rung 3: 32 lanes in lockstep, one batched inversion per step; signed-Frobenius class representative (least normal-basis rotation, sign by y); 32 r-adding jumps in G; stride starts [c]G + Q
